title: Ditch Google Analytics: Why Rybbit is Your New Open-Source, Privacy-First Analytics Best Friend!
published: True
tags: web, open, privacy, google
---

## Quick Summary: 📝
Rybbit is an open-source, privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics, designed for intuitive web and product analytics. It offers a comprehensive suite of features without relying on cookies, making it a user-friendly and privacy-conscious choice for tracking website and application user behavior.

## Key Takeaways: 💡

* ✅ Rybbit is an open-source, privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics, offering intuitive web and product analytics.

* ✅ It features comprehensive metrics, including unique capabilities like session replays for deep user behavior insights.

* ✅ Developers gain full data ownership and control through self-hosting options and benefit from cookieless tracking.

* ✅ The platform provides highly customizable dashboards, advanced filtering, and custom events for granular data analysis.

* ✅ Rybbit empowers developers to make data-driven decisions while ensuring user privacy and simplifying compliance.


## Project Statistics: 📊
* ⭐ **Stars:** 12837
* 🍴 **Forks:** 727
* ❗ **Open Issues:** 126


## Tech Stack: 💻
- ✅ TypeScript


Hey fellow developers! Ever felt a bit uneasy about the privacy implications or the sheer complexity of traditional web analytics tools like Google Analytics? I certainly have. That's why I'm absolutely thrilled to share a gem I recently stumbled upon on GitHub: Rybbit! This project isn't just another analytics tool; it's a breath of fresh air, offering a powerful, privacy-friendly, and open-source alternative that's incredibly intuitive to use. It's designed to give you all the crucial insights you need about your users and their behavior, but without compromising their privacy or making you jump through hoops.

So, what exactly is Rybbit? Imagine a robust web and product analytics platform that gives you all the core web analytics metrics you'd expect, like sessions, unique users, pageviews, bounce rate, and session duration. But it goes way beyond that! One of its standout features is **session replays**, letting you literally watch how users interact with your site. This is a game-changer for understanding user experience and identifying pain points. Under the hood, Rybbit is designed with simplicity and control in mind. You can either use their hosted service or, for ultimate control, **self-host** it on your own VPS. This means you own your data, a huge win for many of us. It's built to be cookieless and privacy-friendly from the ground up, so you can rest easy knowing you're respecting your users' data.

The dashboards are super customizable, allowing you to set up goals, track retention, visualize user journeys, and build funnels. Plus, with advanced filtering across over 15 dimensions and custom events with JSON properties, you can slice and dice your data in incredibly granular ways to get truly actionable insights. It even boasts advanced map visualizations for location tracking and a real-time dashboard so you can see the impact of your changes instantly. For teams, Rybbit supports organizations and an unlimited number of sites, making it scalable for projects of all sizes.

Why should you, a developer, care about Rybbit? First, **privacy compliance** is becoming increasingly critical, and Rybbit makes it effortless by being cookieless and privacy-friendly. No more complex cookie banners or worrying about data regulations. Second, the ability to **self-host** gives you complete ownership and control over your analytics infrastructure and data, which is invaluable for many projects and companies. Third, the **session replays** and detailed user profiles offer an unparalleled understanding of user behavior, helping you debug UX issues, optimize conversion funnels, and make data-driven decisions faster. Imagine being able to see exactly where users get stuck or what features they love! Its real-time dashboard means you can see the impact of your deployments instantly. For developers building SaaS products or complex web applications, Rybbit's support for custom events with JSON properties and organization features means it scales with your needs, providing deep product analytics without the vendor lock-in or high costs of proprietary solutions. It's truly an empowering tool for any dev looking for a modern, ethical, and powerful analytics solution!
